_note: visual_verify expectations for a finished 공문 (pipeline/scripts/visual_verify.py --expectations). Modules are the natural author of this file and there is no provides key for it: it is ordinary payload the caller passes. forbidden_text is the regulation's guide vocabulary — the render must not SHOW a term the 별지서식 비고 says to replace, which is the visual twin of check_gongmun's guide_vocabulary_residue rule. intentionally_blank names the seats a human completes by hand, so a fill_map the caller composes per document does not have to claim them. Page geometry is NOT declared here: the 별지서식 prescribes 210x297 but a 공문 body may run to several pages, so page_budget stays the caller's call and visual_verify lists it under deterministic.skipped.
